diagnostic_scope: FIXED 100-SAMPLE CV-BENCH SCREENING. This is a single-variable context-pooling ablation of the frozen layer-5 L2 path and is explicitly NOT a formal full2638 CV-Bench conclusion. No formal accuracy, promotion, acceleration or hardware claim may be derived from it.
round_scope: CPU-only preregistration, summariser and tests. No GPU run, no board run, no training, no hyper-parameter tuning, no dependency installation. The representative-arm raw JSONL is produced later by the host GPU runner exactly as pinned below; it did not exist when this file was written.
ablation_question: Holding the frozen layer-5 L2 selector, K=96, region_grid=3, local_cap=16 and identical selection metadata/indices/positions fixed, does replacing every SOURCE_CONTEXT pooled group with its raw representative 2x2 group change the official CV-Bench screening100 accuracy by more than 0.02 (representative minus pooled)?

single_variable_contract.baseline: frozen layer5 L2 pooled artifact produced by evaluation/run_hf_hardware_regular_layer5_l2.py
identical: frozen select_hardware_regular_groups output metadata: group_indices, patch_indices, source_type, region_id, valid
representative patch positions used for compact cos/sin
DeepStack index 5 called on the compact hidden
single_variable_contract.only_change: For every SOURCE_CONTEXT output slot, the compact hidden row uses cut_hidden[group_indices[slot]] (the raw representative 2x2 group) instead of the pooled selection.groups[slot]. SOURCE_REAL slots are unchanged.
single_variable_contract.verification: The treatment integration re-derives the frozen pooled selection from the same inputs, asserts full metadata/index/position equality, asserts every SOURCE_REAL slot equals its raw 2x2 group, and records context_slots_replaced.

arms.dense: frozen custom dense (unpruned) path; REFERENCE ONLY, never decision-driving
arms.representative_layer5_l2: layer-5 L2 with SOURCE_CONTEXT slots replaced by the raw representative 2x2 group

primary_metric.definition: Official CV-Bench combined score returned by the frozen scorer evaluation.build_cv_bench_pruning_report.score: ((accuracy_ADE20K + accuracy_COCO)/2 + accuracy_Omni3D)/2.
primary_metric.rule: This is the ONE and ONLY primary metric for every arm (dense, pooled, representative) and for every paired bootstrap comparison. It is never replaced by any other accuracy.

unweighted_metric.definition: Plain unweighted mean over the 100 screening samples.
unweighted_metric.rule: Secondary diagnostic only. It must never be called the CV-Bench primary score and must never drive the decision rule.

dense.subset_rule: restricted to the 100 sample_id values of datasets/cv_bench_screening100.jsonl, preserving manifest order
dense.role: REFERENCE ONLY: unpruned custom-dense reference; it never drives the decision

pooled_layer5_l2.role: frozen layer-5 L2 pooled baseline, K=96, screening100

representative_layer5_l2.role: layer-5 L2 single-variable context-pooling ablation arm (raw representative 2x2 context groups)
representative_layer5_l2.generation_command: python evaluation/run_hf_hardware_regular_layer5_context_ablation.py --model <frozen BF16 RoboBrain2.5-4B> --model-label <label> --manifest datasets/cv_bench_screening100.jsonl --output artifacts/token_selector/2026-10-04-layer5-context-pooling-ablation/layer5_context_ablation_k96_screening100.jsonl --score-mode l2 --prune-after-layer 5 --budget 96 --region-grid 3 --local-candidate-cap 16 --dtype bf16 --device cuda:0

validation_requirements.sample_id_identity: The screening manifest, the dense full2638 subset, the pooled baseline and the representative arm must all select exactly the same 100 sample_id values.
validation_requirements.no_duplicates: Each of the four inputs must contain no duplicate sample_id.
validation_requirements.score_mode_l2: Every pooled and every representative record must have score_mode == "l2".
validation_requirements.budget_k96: Every pooled and every representative record must have requested_budget == 96; every non-bypass record must emit exactly K=96 output groups.
validation_requirements.cutpoint_5: Every pooled and every representative record must carry prune_after_layer == 5.
validation_requirements.input_grid_consistency: For every sample_id, the representative record's (image_grid_thw, full_patch_tokens, full_llm_visual_tokens) must equal the pooled record's tuple.
validation_requirements.selection_metadata_identity: For every sample_id, selected_group_indices, source_type, region_id and valid must be element-wise identical between the pooled baseline and the representative arm; context_group_count and real_group_count must also match. A mismatch invalidates the single-variable claim and the summariser must fail closed.
validation_requirements.ablation_declaration: Every representative record must declare context_group_values_source == "representative_raw_group" and uses_pooled_context_group_values == false; context_slots_replaced must equal context_group_count.
validation_requirements.input_sha256: Every non-null inputs_sha256 pin in this file is re-verified before scoring.
validation_requirements.fail_closed: If any required input file is missing, or any of the checks above fails, the summariser must raise and must NOT write a report.

decision_rule.uses: 95% CI of score(...)["cv_bench_accuracy"] for representative_minus_pooled only
decision_rule.dense_role: reference only; never drives the decision

ordered_rules.meaning: 上下文池化有害已确认：丢弃 pooled 上下文、改用代表原始 2x2 group 后，官方 CV-Bench 主分提升超过 0.02。
上下文池化有害未确认：证据不足以证明用代表原始 group 替换 pooled 上下文能带来超过 0.02 的提升。

explicit_non_formal_statement: This diagnostic runs on a fixed stratified 100-sample screening set. Its result is a single-variable context-pooling attribution signal only and is NOT a formal full2638 CV-Bench conclusion; it must not be quoted as the official CV-Bench accuracy of any approach, and it does not authorise promotion, RTL work or hardware claims.
limitations: Screening100 is a diagnostic subset, not the formal 2638-sample CV-Bench benchmark.
The Selector path is software only; no FPGA/board result and no latency/acceleration claim is made.
Both Selector arms share the frozen selection metadata and K=96 and differ only in the SOURCE_CONTEXT group values; dense is a reference, not an exactly matched input grid.
Only score(...)["cv_bench_accuracy"] drives the decision; unweighted_sample_accuracy is descriptive.
Neither arm uses the B1-trained Wv projection.
Validation was already used in development; internal test remains sealed.
